title: spec: an agent's model name becomes optional — absent means the environment's default model
body:
epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMmczBEaeiAQ48oDtz

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task · Source: objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 — Jack 2026-11-26, decision card in the epic seat thread, chose 「框架允许省略 model」 (the agent's `model.model` becomes optional; absent = follow the environment's default model).
Grade: p2 · area:ai · Task · evidence: read (objectstack main dedc16c1)
Reader: epic:#5055 seat (objectstack-ai/cloud#5055) → card thread. Milestone M1.
Dedupe: open objectstack issues on `AIModelConfigSchema` → none with this change.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：agent 元数据里 `model.model`（具体模型名）现在必填，`temperature` 也只能写在同一个块里。改成可以省略模型名，省略就跟随部署的默认模型。
- 影响：云端内置 agent 可以去掉残留的 `gpt-4`、保留 `temperature: 0.2`；AI 写自定义 agent 时也不必编一个模型名。第二阶段的档位字段接在这里。
- 要你做什么：无（你已在决策卡上选定这条路）。

## Current state (objectstack main dedc16c1)
- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:27-42` `AIModelConfigSchema` (strict object): `provider` enum default `'openai'`, `model: z.string()` required, `temperature` default 0.7, `maxTokens`, `topP`. `AgentSchema.model` is `AIModelConfigSchema.optional()` (`:340`).
- So an agent that only wants `temperature` must still name a model; cloud's built-in ask and metadata-assistant declare `model: 'gpt-4'` for that reason (`objectstack-ai/cloud` `packages/service-ai-studio/src/agents/ask-agent.ts:116`, `metadata-assistant-agent.ts:79`), which the cloud chat route has to neutralise.
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-list-registry.ts:203` lists `model.model` as a column; generated metadata-form translations carry `model.model`.

Re-check: `git grep -n "model: z.string().describe('Model name" -- packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` → 1 hit.

## What to do
1. Make `model` inside `AIModelConfigSchema` optional; its description says that absent means the host's default model for this environment.
2. Regenerate whatever the spec change regenerates (JSON schema, forms, translations, baselines) per AGENTS.md; the list column shows an empty/"default" value for an agent with no model.
3. Do not add a tier or sentinel value; tiers are phase 2 of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055.
4. If `provider` turns out to be read by no runtime (declared, not enforced), note it in the PR's Acceptance notes for the seat; do not remove it here.

## Acceptance
- An agent with `model: { temperature: 0.2 }` parses; one with `model: { model: 'x' }` parses as before; unknown keys are still refused.
- `Metadata-protocol:` line from the diff (this widens what an author may write; the dev names the kind per AGENTS.md) and the `Skills-docs:` line it owes; changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.
- Spec gates per AGENTS.md (`pnpm check:all` phases the diff triggers).

## Fences
- File surface: `packages/spec/**` and the generated files the spec gates require, `skills/**` only if the docs line says `updated here` on a `domain:skills`-owned path (otherwise `follow-up`). Stop on breach.
- Cloud picks this up after a pin move; the cloud card of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 removes the built-ins' `gpt-4`.

## References
Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/3sJqSZVv3Lf3NoViD9Q4cU (方案 5 框架). Parent objectstack-ai/cloud#5055.
